recentEventsByGoal.objective: Deliver a full, visually distinctive redesign of the B3 Explorer UI across the Streamlit home/fundamentals page and all four feature pages (Portfolio, Simulação, Notícias, Screener), responding to the user's feedback that the current light UI is too simple. Preserve the B3Lab identity, existing Brazilian Portuguese copy, current financial calculations and feature behavior, accessible keyboard and reduced-motion behavior, responsive layout, and the shared workspace's pre-existing uncommitted edits; do not add dependencies or commit. Tier: HEAVY, because this is a cross-page design-system and layout redesign spanning shared styling, charts, and five user-visible routes. Success criteria: (1) The updated DESIGN.md contract and shared visual system are implemented before page-specific styling; PASS when the live app is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:8502 and the five routes `/`, `/Portfolio`, `/Simulação`, `/Notícias`, `/Screener` each render a visible page heading and a fresh 1280x900 screenshot in `/tmp/b3lab-full-redesign/desktop/`. (2) The full feature set remains regression-free; PASS when `PYTHONPATH=. pytest` exits 0 with no skipped or xfailed tests, with the run output recorded in the notepad. (3) Responsive and interaction behavior is proven on the real rendered app; through omowright `connectPipe` against the same URL, capture all five routes at 768x1024 and 375x812, verify `document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth`, drive sidebar navigation and keyboard focus with `page.keyboard.press('Tab')`, and verify `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` leaves no nonessential animation running; save captures and action log under `/tmp/b3lab-full-redesign/`. (4) Independent visual QA passes on fresh evidence for all five pages at 375, 768, and 1280 widths, with no blocking layout, accessibility, or design-system findings; reviewer inputs include the screenshot paths, source diff, and objective overflow/focus results, and reviewer verdicts are recorded in the notepad. Stop when the updated design system is in use, all five routes pass the live browser scenarios at all three widths, `PYTHONPATH=. pytest` exits 0, independent reviewers return PASS with no blockers, and spawned QA resources are cleaned up with receipts.
